units.source_text: 他把两个男孩载在车中，和他们共话，一路回家。

en.t: He took the two boys into the carriage and talked with them as they went home together.

units.source_text: 他不带他们到六条院，却载他们回到自邸，对他们说：“你们还是住在这里的好，我来探望也方便些。”

en.t: He did not take them to the Rokujo estate, but brought them back to his own residence and said to them, "It will be better for you to stay here. It will also be easier for me to come and see you."
After saying this, he went on to the Rokujo estate.

units.source_text: 两个儿子寂寞无聊，茫茫然地目送父亲出门，样子怪可怜的，使得髭黑大将又添了一种愁思。

en.t: The two sons, lonely and listless, watched their father leave in a daze. Their pitiful appearance added another sorrow to General Higekuro's heart.

units.source_text: 但一到六条院，看见了玉鬘的美貌，拿来和他那怪僻的正夫人一比较，觉得天差地远，他的万种愁思都消失了。

en.t: But once he arrived at the Rokujo estate and saw Tamakazura's beauty, he compared her with his eccentric principal wife and felt they were worlds apart; all his many sorrows vanished.

units.source_text: 此后他就以前日走访遭逢拒绝为理，和正夫人断绝往来，音信不通。

en.t: After that, using the refusal he had met with on his earlier visit as an excuse, he broke off all contact with his principal wife and sent no word at all.

units.source_text: 式部卿亲王闻之，痛恨他的无情，愁叹不已。

en.t: When Prince Shikibukyo heard of this, he bitterly resented the man's heartlessness and grieved without end.

units.source_text: 紫姬也闻知此事，叹道：“连我也被父亲痛恨了，真冤枉啊！”

en.t: Lady Murasaki also heard about it and sighed, "Even I have been hated by my father. How unfair this is!"

units.source_text: 源氏觉得对她不起，安慰她道：“做人真难啊！

en.t: Genji felt sorry toward her and comforted her, saying, "It is truly difficult to live as a human being!

units.source_text: 玉鬘之事，不是我一人可以做主的，却又与我有关。

en.t: The matter of Tamakazura is not something I alone can decide, yet I am involved in it.

units.source_text: 因此皇上也疑心我作梗，萤兵部卿亲王也埋怨我。

en.t: For that reason, His Majesty also suspects that I interfered, and Prince Hotaru Hyobukyo blames me as well.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，萤兵部卿亲王是个颇能谅解的人，他查明底细之后，怨恨自会消解。

en.t: Even so, Prince Hotaru Hyobukyo is a man of considerable understanding. Once he learns the full circumstances, his resentment will naturally fade.

units.source_text: 男女相爱之事，即使力求秘密，后来自会显露真相。

en.t: When a man and woman love each other, even if they try hard to keep it secret, the truth will reveal itself in time.

units.source_text: 我想你父亲不会归罪于我们吧。”

en.t: I think your father will not lay the blame on us."
